lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Let me be clear, I came here to drop the mic

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Two terms, no scandals, now that's a clean strike

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Hope was my anthem, change was the plan

lines.text: You're tweeting at midnight, I was leading the land

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Nobel on my shelf, you got a golden toilet seat

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Healthcare for the nation while you golfed every week

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Cool, calm, collected, that's presidential grace

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Yes we can, yes we did, now get up out my face

lines.text: Wrong, totally wrong, Barack, sad little act

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: I'm the comeback king, everybody knows that's fact

lines.text: Biggest crowds ever, nobody's seen such love

lines.text: You had hope and change, but I get the final word
